title: Council registration proof — Espaço Prelúdio

intro.lead: To unlock the recent-graduate discount (R$ 99.50/month instead of R$ 199.00), we need to confirm that your registration with a regulated council (CRP, CRM, CRESS, CREFITO, CRFa, CRN, CRO or CREF) happened in the last 12 months. Upload one of these:

list.i1Html: Photo/scan of your professional ID card issued by the council — works for any of the 8 councils.
list.i2Html: Screenshot of the official public registry of your council (e.g. CFP National Registry (CRP), CFM portal (CRM)) showing your registration date.

dropzone.title: Click to choose or drag the file here
dropzone.hint: PDF, PNG or JPG · up to 5 MB

loading.title: Validating document…
loading.hint: Reading the council registration date. It may take 10–30 seconds.

approved.h2: You qualify for the Recent-graduate plan.
approved.nextHtml: Next step: subscribe to the recurring plan at R$ 99.50/month via Mercado Pago.

review.lead: Some details need to be reviewed by a human before approval. We'll email you within 48h.

rejected.fallback: If your registration is older than 12 months, you can subscribe directly to the Professional plan (R$ 199/month).

privacyHtml: Privacy: your proof is stored encrypted, accessible only by the verification team. It is automatically discarded 90 days after validation.

js.badFormat: Unsupported format. Send PDF, PNG or JPG.
js.defaultReason: Document does not meet the requirements.
